name: AvidXchange
summary: AvidXchange sells invoice and payment automation to mid-sized businesses, with no published prices and a demo request instead. Its invoice page describes capture at header and line-item level, approval routing with an AI approval agent, and 2-way or 3-way matching. Suppliers are paid by virtual credit card, AvidPay Direct or mailed check.

facts.text: AvidXchange says its AI extracts invoice data at header and line-item level with 99%+ accuracy.
AvidXchange says its AI Approval Agent recommends approvals from historical approval data, and that approvers keep the final decision.
The home page names virtual credit card, AvidPay Direct and mailed checks as supplier payment options.
AvidXchange describes itself as a licensed money transmitter for B2B payments in the United States.
The security page shows a PCI DSS compliant logo and says AvidXchange is guided by COSO, PCI DSS and NIST.

hiddenCosts: No fees for invoices, payments or supplier payment methods are published.
